answer: Locks are written down in jade, expire in relic, and canyon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 172 aliases therefore needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 115 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
